caption: The drawing depicts a single, large, rounded clay pot with a wide body and a narrow, unevenly broken rim at the top. The pot is rendered in earthy brown and reddish-brown tones, with subtle gradations to suggest light and shadow on its curved surface. The rim appears thick and there are two small, rounded handles on opposite sides near the neck. The inside of the pot is dark, with a visible shadowy interior. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white color with no additional objects or elements present, focusing attention entirely on the pot.
title: Jar
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
